nodes.title: Yarn editor (draft "AutoTime")
nodes.notes: App opens directly in the project editor: Script/Agent panel (left), drawn canvas (center), top bar, status bar, playback toolbar, drawn timeline (bottom).

nodes.title: Global left rail
nodes.notes: Library, Your Drafts, draft list (AutoTime, UntitledProduct Launch Demo, many Untitled), New draft, Invite Members, Brand Kit, Settings.

nodes.title: Script / Agent panel
nodes.notes: Tabs Agent|Script; title field; Select voice popup; Project actions ellipses; scene headers Intro 02:49 / Releases 00:33; Camera webcam blocks; transcript sentences are individual AXTextAreas (ProseMirror); Agent composer at the bottom.

nodes.title: Preview canvas (drawn)
nodes.notes: x≈545-1560, y≈84-655 screenshot px. Fully painted video frame incl. burned-in caption. Only AX child: label 'Previewing sync point'. No selection handles exposed.

nodes.title: Timeline (drawn region)
nodes.notes: x≈545-1560, y≈710-881. Rows: time ruler y≈727 (labels 55/1:00/1:05/1:10 + scene name), zoom lane y≈745-760 ('Fixed Zoom' clips, selected drawn blue at y≈783), empty overlay/media lanes, purple screen-recording clip y≈805-830 with white sync-point dots at y≈817 and lighter Skip blocks, transcript chip row y≈851, vertical playhead. AX exposes only degenerate 1px labels; read from screenshot, act by pixel.

nodes.title: Playhead / scrub
nodes.notes: Click anywhere in the timeline to scrub. Verifiable as TEXT in the toolbar clock (mm:ss:ff), e.g. '01:14:60'→'01:17:56'→'01:10:66'; total '03:22:20'. Not persisted document state.

nodes.title: Sync point dot (drawn mark)
nodes.notes: Single click = NO effect (no selection, no readout). Press-drag-release DOES move it: dragging (1007,817)→(1070,817) shifted that dot and all later dots/Skip blocks right by the same delta (re-times the clip). No text readout of its own time anywhere. Undo with cmd+z (foreground).

nodes.title: Clip context menu (drawn only)
nodes.notes: Right-click the purple clip. NOT in the AX tree. Items: 'Add Skip…  Cmd+E', 'Add Sync Point  Cmd+S', 'Split clip  Cmd+Shift+S', 'Reset to original time', 'Delete'. Escape (foreground) closes it but does not deselect the clip.

nodes.title: Edit Skip button / Skip segment
nodes.notes: Skip regions are lighter blocks inside the purple clip; AX button 'Edit Skip' (.ag-editor-timeline-clip-segment--skip-openSkipBtn) exists but with tiny frames. Hover tooltips 'Adjust Skip start' / 'Adjust Skip end' follow the pointer.

nodes.title: Timeline Zoom popup
nodes.notes: AXPopUpButton 'Timeline Zoom' (.ag-editor-toolbar-btn--timelineZoom) at the right of the playback toolbar; view-only zoom of the timeline.

nodes.title: Add Zoom
nodes.notes: Top-bar button shown when nothing is selected; inserts a zoom clip at the playhead (not exercised).

nodes.title: Zoom type popup (selected clip) — 'Fixed'
nodes.notes: Appears in the top bar only while a screen/zoom clip is selected, alongside '− Zoom +' and instant-zoom start/end buttons.

nodes.title: Entrance/Exit animation popup (project clip)
nodes.notes: Top-bar popup .editor-topbar-btn--animation--screenVideo — same component/class as the Brand Kit 'Fade Up' control, but edits this project's clip.

nodes.title: Sound effects popup (project clip)
nodes.notes: Top-bar popup .editor-topbar-btn--soundEffects; per-project counterpart of Brand Kit → Screen Clips → Sound Effects.

nodes.title: Captions button
nodes.notes: Status bar (top-right) .ag-editor-statusBar-btn--captions; opens caption settings for this project (not opened).

nodes.title: Music popup
nodes.notes: Shows current track 'ES_A Winter to Remember - Trevor Kowalski'.

nodes.title: Publish
nodes.notes: OUTBOUND — do not press.

nodes.title: Export
nodes.notes: OUTBOUND — do not press.

nodes.title: Brand Kit (Default Brand)
nodes.notes: Reached from rail. Sub-nav: Brand Overview, Templates, Workflows, Colors, Type, Screen Clips, Motion, Layout, Misc.

nodes.title: Brand Kit → Screen Clips (Screen Clip Settings)
nodes.notes: Sections: Cursor, Screen Display, Sound Effects, Visual Effects. All values are brand-wide defaults for new screen clips.

nodes.title: Cursor Style
nodes.notes: AXComboBox .dpSelectBtn, current value 'Arrow-first'. No per-project equivalent found in the editor top bar during this pass.

nodes.title: Cursor Scale
nodes.notes: Slider, value 1.60.

nodes.title: Entrance/Exit Animation (brand default)
nodes.notes: Popup rendered with class .editor-topbar-btn--animation--screenVideo, identical to the editor top-bar control — but this store is the BRAND default.

nodes.title: Sound Effects (brand default)
options: Keyboard Presses: Set B / Extra Soft
nodes.notes: Two checkboxes plus combo boxes.

nodes.title: Default Zoom Type
nodes.notes: Brand default; the per-clip override lives in the editor top bar when a clip is selected.

nodes.title: Default Zoom Level
nodes.notes: Slider, 54%.

nodes.title: Motion Blur
nodes.notes: Currently Medium.

nodes.title: Settings (rail)
nodes.notes: Not visited this pass. NOTE: there is no macOS Preferences item and cmd+, does nothing — app settings live only here.

nodes.title: macOS menu bar (Yarn)
nodes.notes: Apple / Yarn (About, Services, Hide, Quit) / File (Close Window, Close All) / Edit (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Substitutions, Speech, Writing Tools, AutoFill, Emoji & Symbols) / View (Reload, Force Reload, Toggle Developer Tools, Actual Size, Zoom In/Out) / Window / Help. No Preferences/Settings item.
